versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g Mapping between a DiagnosticRoutineSub- function and a CpSoftwareClusterResource The creation of a mapping be- tween a concrete sub-class of DiagnosticRoutineSubfunction and a CpSoft- wareClusterResource by means of a CpSwClusterToDiagRoutineSubfunc- tionMapping supports configuration of the transport of call and return arguments of a diagnostic routine call across the boundaries of a CpSoftwareCluster .
